summary: Jasper County, TX Texas Forest Service tower listed as gone; a September 1962 contract quoted on the Forest Lookouts page was for reconstructing the Evadale Lookout Tower.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Texas list; no removal date in the sources read

events.note: Additional $3,805 contract for reconstruction of the Evadale Lookout Tower, quoted from The Eagle, dated September 20, 1962; completion of the work is not confirmed in the sources read

evidence.supports: Evadale listed in Jasper County at 30.27139, -94.03722, as a tower that is gone
agency is the Texas Forest Service
the quoted contract notice is dated September 20, 1962
$48,960 contract to O.C. Braly of Overton for building eight fire lookout towers for the Texas Forest Service
evidence.quote: Contract for $48,960 to O.C. Braly of Overton for building of eight fire lookout towers for the Texas Forest Service

evidence.supports: $3,805 contract for reconstruction of the Evadale Lookout Tower
evidence.quote: plus an additional $3,805 contract for reconstruction of the Evadale Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The only site-specific history is the 1962 contract notice that the Forest Lookouts page quotes from The Eagle; the original newspaper was not read. The first tower's build date is not in any source read. Removal date and current site condition are not in the sources. Search results for Evadale showed FCC-registered antenna towers in Evadale, which are not this lookout, and a 2020s Shearwood Creek fire report that names the agency as Texas A&M Forest Service; neither was used for the story.
